select count(*) as "count" from (
  select l.id, l.nombre, l.tipo, l.subtipo, l.ciudad, l.estado, l.suscripcion, l.email, l.telefono, l.sitio_web, l.url_gmap, l.perfil_instagram, l.perfil_facebook, l.perfil_airbnb, l.perfil_booking, l.perfil_turismo_entre_rios, l.origen, l.quien_cargo, l.asignado_a, l.fecha_creacion, l.fecha_ultimo_contacto, l.medio_contacto_preferido, l.resultado_ultimo_contacto, l.prioridad, l.fecha_proxima_accion, l.fuente_referencia, l.cliente_potencial_recurrente, l.archivo_adjunto, l.notas, l.creado_por, l.created_at, l.updated_at, coalesce(mpc.name,(select c.name from crm_contacts c where c.account_id=l.account_id and c.deleted_at is null order by c.is_primary desc, c.id limit 1),l.contact_name) as contact_name, l.deleted_at, l.deleted_by_user_id, l.deleted_by_email, l.deleted_by_name, l.assigned_user_email, l.commercial_profile, l.account_id, l.opportunity_name, l.primary_contact_id, l.service_interest, l.estimated_close_date, l.assigned_at, l.contact_baseline_date, l.contact_baseline_result, l.stage_since, l.pipeline_revision, l.reactivated_from_id, l.creation_request_key, l.creation_request_hash, l.management_type, l.referred_previous_stage, l.referred_previous_assigned_user_email
  from leads l
  left join crm_contacts mpc on mpc.id = l.primary_contact_id and mpc.account_id = l.account_id and mpc.deleted_at is null
) as "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and (exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $1, '', 'g'), NFC) like normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($2, '')), NFD), $3, '', 'g'), NFC)) or not exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $4, '', 'g'), NFC) like normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($5, '')), NFD), $6, '', 'g'), NFC)) or exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $7, '', 'g'), NFC) = normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($8, '')), NFD), $9, '', 'g'), NFC)) or not exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $10, '', 'g'), NFC) = normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($11, '')), NFD), $12, '', 'g'), NFC)) or not exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id") or exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id"))

select * from (
  select l.id, l.nombre, l.tipo, l.subtipo, l.ciudad, l.estado, l.suscripcion, l.email, l.telefono, l.sitio_web, l.url_gmap, l.perfil_instagram, l.perfil_facebook, l.perfil_airbnb, l.perfil_booking, l.perfil_turismo_entre_rios, l.origen, l.quien_cargo, l.asignado_a, l.fecha_creacion, l.fecha_ultimo_contacto, l.medio_contacto_preferido, l.resultado_ultimo_contacto, l.prioridad, l.fecha_proxima_accion, l.fuente_referencia, l.cliente_potencial_recurrente, l.archivo_adjunto, l.notas, l.creado_por, l.created_at, l.updated_at, coalesce(mpc.name,(select c.name from crm_contacts c where c.account_id=l.account_id and c.deleted_at is null order by c.is_primary desc, c.id limit 1),l.contact_name) as contact_name, l.deleted_at, l.deleted_by_user_id, l.deleted_by_email, l.deleted_by_name, l.assigned_user_email, l.commercial_profile, l.account_id, l.opportunity_name, l.primary_contact_id, l.service_interest, l.estimated_close_date, l.assigned_at, l.contact_baseline_date, l.contact_baseline_result, l.stage_since, l.pipeline_revision, l.reactivated_from_id, l.creation_request_key, l.creation_request_hash, l.management_type, l.referred_previous_stage, l.referred_previous_assigned_user_email
  from leads l
  left join crm_contacts mpc on mpc.id = l.primary_contact_id and mpc.account_id = l.account_id and mpc.deleted_at is null
) as "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and (exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $1, '', 'g'), NFC) like normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($2, '')), NFD), $3, '', 'g'), NFC)) or not exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $4, '', 'g'), NFC) like normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($5, '')), NFD), $6, '', 'g'), NFC)) or exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $7, '', 'g'), NFC) = normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($8, '')), NFD), $9, '', 'g'), NFC)) or not exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $10, '', 'g'), NFC) = normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($11, '')), NFD), $12, '', 'g'), NFC)) or not exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id") or exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id")) order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $13 offset $14
